<!--
  New Feature or Bug Fix Pull Request for Re-Avaritia Fabric
    Re-Avaritia Fabric 新功能或错误修复拉取请求
  Implement an idea for this project or fix a bug to help us improve.
    为本项目实现一个想法或修复一个错误，以帮助我们改进。

  Insert "[Enhancement] " or "[Bug] " before the first word in the title.
    在标题的第一个词前插入「[Enhancement] 」或「[Bug] 」。
  Target the fabric/1.20 branch, not a branch for another mod loader.
    请以 fabric/1.20 分支为目标，不要提交到其他模组加载器的分支。
  The PR may be closed if you do not follow the instructions.
    如果不按说明操作，拉取请求可能会被关闭。
-->

### Checks / 检查

<!--
  Complete these checks before submitting a pull request. Set [ ] to [x].
    在提交拉取请求之前完成以下检查，将 [ ] 设置为 [x]。
-->

- [ ] I have [searched existing issues and pull requests](https://github.com/Nova-Committee/Re-Avaritia/issues?q=) to avoid duplicate work.  
      我已[搜索现有问题和拉取请求](https://github.com/Nova-Committee/Re-Avaritia/issues?q=)，以避免重复工作。
- [ ] This PR targets `fabric/1.20` and changes Re-Avaritia Fabric for Minecraft 1.20.1.  
      此拉取请求以 `fabric/1.20` 为目标，修改的是 Minecraft 1.20.1 的 Re-Avaritia Fabric。
- [ ] I have documented the applicable build, test, and client checks below, including anything not run and why.  
      我已在下方记录适用的构建、测试和客户端检查，并说明未执行的检查及原因。
- [ ] I understand that PRs not following these instructions may be closed.  
      我理解未按说明提交的拉取请求可能会被关闭。

### Related Issues / 相关的 GitHub 问题

<!--
  List issues related to this PR. If none, write "N/A".
    请列出与此拉取请求相关的问题；若没有，请填写「N/A」。
  Use GitHub issue references or closing keywords when appropriate.
    适用时请使用 GitHub 问题引用或关闭问题的关键词。
-->

### Description / 描述

<!--
  For a bug fix, describe the bug, its cause, and how the change fixes it.
    对于错误修复，请描述错误、原因，以及此改动如何修复它。
  For a new feature, describe the feature or change and what it improves.
    对于新功能，请描述新增功能或改动，以及它带来的改善。
  Add screenshots when helpful, after removing private information.
    可附上有助于解释的截图，并先移除私人信息。
-->

### Build, Test, and Client Evidence / 构建、测试与客户端证据

<!--
  Record the exact commands and observed results for applicable Gradle builds
  and tests. For gameplay or rendering changes, describe the actual client
  checks, environment, and observations; include screenshots or logs if helpful.
    对适用的 Gradle 构建和测试，请记录准确命令与实际结果。对玩法或渲染改动，
    请说明实际客户端检查、环境和观察结果；可附上有用的截图或日志。
  Distinguish automated tests from manual client checks. State "not run" or
  "not applicable" with a reason where appropriate; do not claim unperformed checks.
    请区分自动化测试与手动客户端检查。适用时说明「未执行」或「不适用」及原因，
    不要声称完成未执行的检查。
  Remove secrets and personal information from all evidence before posting publicly.
    公开提交前，请从所有证据中移除秘密凭据和个人信息。
-->
